item.title: Legroom 1.0.5
item.description:
Legroom 1.0.5

  • Icon fix. With the Clear or Tinted icon style, the icon showed a filled triangle inside the L. It now looks right in every icon style.

item.title: Legroom 1.0.4
item.description:
Legroom 1.0.4

  • New icon. An L for Legroom, drawn as a seat in profile, with a green dash for the room in front of it. It's made in Apple's new icon format, so recent versions of macOS no longer shrink it onto a white plate in the Dock, and it has proper dark, clear and tinted versions.
  • The mark in the sidebar and the menu bar icon follow the new drawing.

item.title: Legroom 1.0.3
item.description:
Legroom 1.0.3

  • Widgets are easier to read too. The desktop and Notification Center widgets now use the same darker gray text the app got in 1.0.2.

item.title: Legroom 1.0.2
item.description:
Legroom 1.0.2

  • Easier to read. Gray text (labels, captions, file paths) is now dark enough to read comfortably in light mode, and the smallest notes are brighter in dark mode.
  • A softer black. The main buttons and the selected tab use a soft ink instead of pure black and white.
  • Legroom is a Marcaí app: you'll find the signature at the bottom of the sidebar.

item.title: Legroom 1.0.1
item.description:
Legroom 1.0.1

  • Lock the keyboard to clean it. Click Lock Keyboard in the Overview (or the keyboard button in the menu bar panel) and every key press is ignored while you wipe the keys. The mouse and trackpad keep working: click Unlock Keyboard when you're done, or it unlocks by itself after 3 minutes. The first time, macOS asks you to allow Legroom under Accessibility.

item.title: Legroom 1.0.0
item.description:
Legroom 1.0

  • Installer disks stay out of the way. A disk image left mounted after installing (like Legroom's own DMG) no longer shows up as a second disk.
  • Move to Applications. If you open Legroom straight from the disk image, it offers to move itself to Applications, so it stays after you eject the disk image and can keep itself up to date.

item.title: Legroom 0.9.9
item.description:
Legroom 0.9.9

  • New: Check-up. A plain look at your Mac's built-in defenses (System Integrity, Gatekeeper, FileVault, firewall, XProtect and security updates), the result of Apple's own background malware checks, and everything that opens on its own — grouped by who signed it, with the reason anything is worth a look.
  • Turn off a startup item (its file goes to the Trash, so you can undo it), uninstall the app that owns it, or show it in Finder.
  • Runs only when you click Check Now. No password, no internet, nothing sent anywhere.

item.title: Legroom 0.9.8
item.description:
Legroom 0.9.8

  • Automatic updates. Legroom can now update itself. Use Legroom › Check for Updates…, or turn on automatic checks in Settings.
